mapper.select: SELECT state_code AS stateCode, state_name AS stateName, state_type AS stateType, color, description, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM workflow_states ORDER BY sort_order, state_code
mapper.sql: w.workflow_id, w.tenant_id, w.workflow_code, w.workflow_name, w.description, w.entity_type, w.initial_state_code, w.active_yn, w.is_template, w.parent_workflow_id, w.template_version, w.created_at, w.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_transitions tr WHERE tr.workflow_id = w.workflow_id)::int AS transition_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_instances i WHERE i.workflow_id = w.workflow_id)::int AS instance_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workflow_definitions w WHERE w.tenant_id IS NULL AND w.is_template = TRUE ORDER BY w.entity_type, w.workflow_code

SELECT workflow_id, tenant_id, workflow_code, workflow_name, description, entity_type, initial_state_code, active_yn, is_template, parent_workflow_id, template_version FROM workflow_definitions WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId}
AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_definitions (tenant_id, workflow_code, workflow_name, description, entity_type, initial_state_code, is_template, parent_workflow_id, template_version, active_yn, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workflowCode}, #{workflowName}, #{description}, #{entityType}, #{initialStateCode}, #{isTemplate}, #{parentWorkflowId}, #{templateVersion}, #{activeYn}, #{createdBy}) RETURNING workflow_id
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_definitions SET workflow_name = #{workflowName}, description = #{description}, initial_state_code = #{initialStateCode}, active_yn = #{activeYn}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_transitions (workflow_id, action_code, action_name, from_state_code, to_state_code, button_color, button_icon, comment_required, auto_skip, sort_order, active_yn) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{actionCode}, #{actionName}, #{fromStateCode}, #{toStateCode}, COALESCE(#{buttonColor}, 'default'), #{buttonIcon}, #{commentRequired}, #{autoSkip}, #{sortOrder}, #{activeYn}) RETURNING transition_id
mapper.select: SELECT condition_id AS conditionId, condition_type AS conditionType, role_key AS roleKey, dept_id AS deptId, user_id AS userId FROM workflow_transition_conditions WHERE transition_id = #{transitionId} ORDER BY sort_order, condition_id

SELECT post_action_id AS postActionId, action_type AS actionType, approval_code AS approvalCode, notify_target AS notifyTarget, notify_template AS notifyTemplate, field_path AS fieldPath, field_value AS fieldValue FROM workflow_transition_post_actions WHERE transition_id = #{transitionId} ORDER BY sort_order, post_action_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_transition_conditions (transition_id, condition_type, role_key, dept_id, user_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{transitionId}, #{c.conditionType}, #{c.roleKey}, #{c.deptId}, #{c.userId}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO workflow_transition_post_actions (transition_id, action_type, approval_code, notify_target, notify_template, field_path, field_value, sort_order) VALUES (#{transitionId}, #{p.actionType}, #{p.approvalCode}, #{p.notifyTarget}, #{p.notifyTemplate}, #{p.fieldPath}, #{p.fieldValue}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO workflow_instances (tenant_id, workflow_id, entity_type, entity_id, current_state_code, status, requester_user_id, assignee_user_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{currentStateCode}, 'ACTIVE', #{requesterUserId}, #{assigneeUserId}) RETURNING instance_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.instance_id AS "instanceId", i.tenant_id AS "tenantId", i.workflow_id AS "workflowId", w.workflow_code AS "workflowCode", w.workflow_name AS "workflowName", i.entity_type AS "entityType", i.entity_id AS "entityId", i.current_state_code AS "currentStateCode", s.state_name AS "currentStateName", s.color AS "currentStateColor", i.status, i.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId", u1.name AS "requesterName", i.assignee_user_id AS "assigneeUserId", u2.name AS "assigneeName", i.approval_document_id AS "approvalDocumentId", i.pending_transition_id AS "pendingTransitionId", i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM workflow_instances i JOIN workflow_definitions w ON w.workflow_id = i.workflow_id JOIN workflow_states s ON s.state_code = i.current_state_code LEFT JOIN users u1 ON u1.user_id = i.requester_user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = i.assignee_user_id WHERE i.entity_type = #{entityType} AND i.entity_id = #{entityId} AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.instance_id AS "instanceId", i.tenant_id AS "tenantId", i.workflow_id AS "workflowId", w.workflow_code AS "workflowCode", w.workflow_name AS "workflowName", i.entity_type AS "entityType", i.entity_id AS "entityId", i.current_state_code AS "currentStateCode", s.state_name AS "currentStateName", s.color AS "currentStateColor", i.status, i.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId", u1.name AS "requesterName", i.assignee_user_id AS "assigneeUserId", u2.name AS "assigneeName", i.approval_document_id AS "approvalDocumentId", i.pending_transition_id AS "pendingTransitionId", i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM workflow_instances i JOIN workflow_definitions w ON w.workflow_id = i.workflow_id JOIN workflow_states s ON s.state_code = i.current_state_code LEFT JOIN users u1 ON u1.user_id = i.requester_user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = i.assignee_user_id WHERE i.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_instances SET current_state_code = #{currentStateCode}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
